Kento Alpha 0.1, build 572

In this build

  • The Curve Editor in Kento's design: curves in their channels' colours, keys shaped by their interpolation, the key bar (Smooth, Linear, Constant, Flat) and the curve list.
  • The Dope Sheet: a row per animated knob; drag keys and blocks to retime them, one undo a drag.
  • Shuffle, Shuffle2 and ShuffleCopy route channels in their panels: a grid with a dot per route, layer menus for each input and output, and presets (Straight, Alpha to all, Swap).
  • One timeline: the Timeline sets the Viewer's in and out (drag its brackets, or right-click); the strip under the Viewer is gone.
  • Hold Shift while dragging nodes to snap them to the grid.
  • Viewer guides: drag one off the Viewer's edge to delete it; Viewer > Show guides hides and shows them.
  • Noise, ReadGeo2 and TimeClip show all their controls.
  • Updating from this build to the next installs when Kento quits.

The first build for compositors to try. It opens and saves Nuke-compatible scripts, and is meant for

new work as well as for playing old comps back.

Comps

  • Opens .nk scripts: all 1,388 scripts in Autonomy's census open, with 99% of their nodes built. Saves Nuke-compatible .nk, and .ko, Kento's own file, which keeps everything (tracks, solves, Kento's own settings).
  • Expressions on knobs, Nuke-compatible: worked out live where Kento can, and kept in the script where it can't yet. Known safe Python from comps runs.
  • Autosave, and recovery of an autosave newer than the comp.

Nodes

  • Nuke-compatible nodes, by the names compositors know and checked pixel for pixel: merges, grades, transforms (concatenating), blurs, keyers, Roto and RotoPaint, Read and Write (EXR, DPX, PNG, TIFF, JPEG, ProRes, H.264), 3D cards, cameras and ScanlineRender, and more.
  • New nodes start from your recent or most common values, or their defaults.

The Viewer

  • Up to four Viewers; compare and wipe; guides, aspect masks, rulers; the data passes (depth, motion, normals, IDs, position); Cryptomatte picking; pixel info.
  • On-screen controls for transforms, corner pins, crops, ramps, flares, the Tracker and the Sampler.

Roto and paint

  • Draw Bezier, B-spline, rectangle and ellipse shapes; edit points and tangents, key them (auto-key), set colour, feather and opacity.
  • Paint with a brush, eraser, clone or reveal, with pen pressure; a clone's source moved, turned and scaled. Edit painted strokes afterwards in the Layers panel: their lifetime, opacity, brush, colour and clone source; several at once.
  • The Layers panel: layers, shapes and strokes, renamed, duplicated and reordered by dragging.

Tracking

  • The Tracker tracks in Kento, with tolerance, hand-over to another feature keeping the offset, rejoining the original, and filling gaps from other tracks. Forward and back, or multipass.
  • Tracks over time: a lane per track. Exports to Transform and CornerPin2D, linked or baked.

Expressions

  • The expression helper (Utility menu): Link, Choose, Offset in time, Hold, Wiggle, Oscillate, Ramp, Step, Loop, Clamp and Size, with a live curve; pixel recipes for keys and masks.
  • The pick-whip: drag a knob's state mark onto another knob to link it, or onto a node in the Node Graph to choose one of its knobs.

Help

  • Report a problem: what happened, the comp, the log and the Mac's details, saved as a .zip and filed in the studio bug tracker.

Not yet

  • Scopes, Flipbook, proxy and downscale, and the manual: in the menus, dim.
  • Paint's blur, sharpen, smear, dodge and burn; a clone source from another frame.
  • Roto open splines.
